name: Dumbbell Leg Curl
research: Flat bench (deg 0) turned rot_z 180: pad top z 0.44 runs y -0.03..-0.85 (head end), seat y +0.01..+0.35 (knee end). Face down, root rot X +90. Hip joints (+-0.11,-0.05,0.589). 12 Nov 2026: the dumbbell is now drawn between the feet with a new prop option props.db_F.feet (animate.place_feet_props): handle along the shins (knee -> ankle), centred between the two ankles, 0.13 along the feet toward the toes and -0.01 along the handle, so the top plate's inner face (0.082 from the centre) sits on the soles (0.074 past the ankle line) and the other plate stays in front of the shins. Feet squeezed together: ankles x +-0.058 (foot inner edges ~0.02 apart = the 0.033 handle), knee poles x 0.09. START: ankles (+-0.058,0.85,0.52), knee ~7 deg, foot rot X 90 (toes to the floor, ankle neutral): handle along +Y below the shins, centre ~(0,0.84,0.40), lowest plate z ~0.31, clear of the bench (ends y 0.35). END: ankles (+-0.058,0.40,0.99), knee 96 deg, foot rot 180 (soles to the ceiling): handle vertical, centre ~(0,0.53,0.98), top plate on the soles. Hands grip under the pad near the head: elev 100, plane 85, elbow 80. Hirose 2021 PMC7872291 (prone curl, hip neutral, 30/90 deg); Soga 2021 JSSM. Facts and checks: research/dumbbell_leg_curl.json.
